scope: One fixed decision-v1 realized input; original mmBERT weights in installed upstream ModernBertModel versus existing C# scalar capture. Twenty-five layer checkpoints plus two-row marker vectors. No full operator, tokenizer, language quality, training, AOT or performance acceptance.

execution.upstream_source_identity: Record imported Transformers ModernBERT source path/SHA-256 and version, Torch and NumPy versions; installed wheel build/transitive environment is recorded, not claimed fully hash-locked.

comparison.shape_and_order: Exact checkpoint names/order, [46,768] tensors and [2,768] marker rows
comparison.missing_or_partial: Reject incomplete source or reference; retain all selected comparison failures and full denominator; no partial pass
comparison.after_measurement: Do not widen tolerances in this contract after seeing values. A new reviewed version must preserve this result and explain any revised numerical requirement.
comparison.fixture: Self-test fixture results explicitly remain fixture_only and cannot be accepted as the fixed upstream capture.

evidence_policy: Actual original-weight upstream outputs only; no C# self-comparison as independent oracle. All outputs retain model/input/contract/program hashes, process identity and limitation flags. Formal license and data admission remain unchanged.
